title: On Worrying about the cost all winter
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：worry　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 worry 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the nurse ① worried about the cost all winter for the whole place, and every sufferer in the ward said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the nurse ② worries about the cost all winter without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ worry about the cost all winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ worried about the cost all winter before — a line in the report for April 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Worrying about the cost all winter for the whole place, the nurse said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ worry nobody but his mother without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Worry nobody but his mother at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new sufferer from the next ward ⑧ worries nobody but his mother for the whole place every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cupboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ worried about the cost all winter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To worry about the cost all winter, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the ward remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the ward forgets, somebody worries about the cost all winter without a word of thanks again and somebody must worry about the cost all winter for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 担忧（一般过去式 worried about the cost all winter：1981 年护士头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 担忧（一般现在 worries about the cost all winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 担忧（不定式 to worry about the cost all winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 担忧（过去完成时 had worried about the cost all winter：1975 年四月的护理记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 担忧（动名词 worrying about the cost all winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使担忧（worry nobody but his mother：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使担忧除了他母亲谁也不操心）
G. v. 使担忧（worry nobody but his mother：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 担忧（后段两处：新来的病患照例 worries nobody but his mother，而母亲又一次 worried about the cost all winter）

answers.why: worry 意为“担忧”，1981 年护士替所有人担忧整个冬天都为那笔花销犯愁，那是病房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 worried。
worry 意为“担忧”，自那以后护士不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 worries。
worry 意为“担忧”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯担忧整个冬天都为那笔花销犯愁”，此处为不定式 to worry about the cost all winter。
worry 意为“担忧”，护理记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人担忧过，故用过去完成时 had worried。
worry 意为“担忧”，护士说“担忧整个冬天都为那笔花销犯愁这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 worrying about the cost all winter 作主语。
worry 意为“使担忧”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使担忧除了他母亲谁也不操心”，should ever 之后用原形 worry nobody but his mother。
worry 意为“使担忧”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使担忧除了他母亲谁也不操心（worry nobody but his mother at once），以后再也不要提起。
worry 意为“担忧”，新来的病患每个夜晚都照例使担忧除了他母亲谁也不操心，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 worries。
worry 意为“担忧”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人担忧整个冬天都为那笔花销犯愁，用一般过去式 worried 叙述。
worry 意为“担忧”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要担忧整个冬天都为那笔花销犯愁，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和病房记住的那一件。

早在 1975 年就有人担忧整个冬天都为那笔花销犯愁，四月那天护理记录上的一行字就是证据。（had worried about the cost all winter）

answers: In 1981 the nurse worried about the cost all winter for the whole place, and every sufferer in the ward said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three nights on, the nurse still worries about the cost all winter without a word of thanks without being asked.
My mother said later that to worry about the cost all winter at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had worried about the cost all winter long before 1988, and the line in the report for April proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 worry 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the nurse worried about the cost all winter for the whole place, and nobody in the ward forgot it.
Even now the nurse worries about the cost all winter without a word of thanks whenever the ward asks.
Worrying about the cost all winter for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever worry nobody but his mother without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sufferer from the next ward worries nobody but his mother for the whole place every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother worried about the cost all winter again, and the ward remembered that half.
